snippet_primary: "Etsy confines every shop to the same marketplace template. Sellers can upload a banner, add a logo, and arrange featured items within shop customization. However, they cannot modify page layouts, change typography, access HTML or CSS code, customize checkout pages, or control navigation structure. Every Etsy product page uses a consistent template structure, and the store URL remains at etsy.com/shop/yourname."
subject_exact: Etsy shop customization limits: shared marketplace template, no layout, typography, HTML/CSS, checkout or navigation control, and store URL under etsy.com
local_qualifiers: Sellers can upload a banner, add a logo, and arrange featured items within shop customization
